gates.name: Current data health
gates.detail: All current canonical critical feeds must be green.

gates.name: Evidence integrity
gates.detail: No hard chronology, identity, grading, or closing-line violations.

gates.name: Resolved contextual research sample
gates.detail: Minimum sample before contextual ablation is interpreted.

gates.name: Resolved contextual promotion sample
gates.detail: Materially larger prospective context sample required before promotion can be considered.

gates.name: Explicit CLV coverage
gates.detail: Only explicit pre-tip closes count; missing closes remain missing.

gates.name: Context challenger beats MARKET
gates.detail: Best eligible contextual challenger must beat market Brier on chronological unseen rows.

gates.name: Context challenger beats prior layer
gates.detail: Added context must improve on the preceding surviving feature layer.

policy: No automatic promotion. V5 remains shadow until prospective context, explicit CLV, integrity, health, and chronological challenger gates all pass; even then a separate reviewed production change is required.
